answer: Rotating task-scarce assignment. Each epoch the coordinator assigns agents to a narrow ridge of tasks drawn from a shared queue; unused slots expire. An identity accumulates no credit for self-generated work—only for completing assigned tasks confirmed by independent verifiers, and task draws are gated by prior completion, not by gale of registrations. A juniper-tagged ledger records each identity's slot history. To sustain Sybil identities an attacker must staff real verifier-confirmed work per slot, paying full labor and idle costs per identity rather than a one-time fee.
